Account	May 2026	June 2026
4010	Patient service revenue, net	$742,000	$803,500
4220	Orthodontic plan revenue	$96,000	$138,400

memo:
1. Dental supplies and lab fees eased to $191,200 in June as the group moved its crown and bridge work to a lower priced lab.
2. Patient service revenue rose $61,500, which is 8.3 percent of May, so the movement fails the percentage leg of the threshold and this line carries no driver.
3. Orthodontic plan revenue of $138,400 includes the eleven treatment plans families paid in full during June, and the whole payment on each plan was taken to revenue in June.
4. Marketing and patient outreach rose $5,700, or 31.0 percent, on the new patient mailer that went out in the first week of June, and the movement fails the dollar leg of the threshold.
5. Hygienist wages increased $44,900 after the second hygiene chair opened at the Ashburn office on June 1.
